Beta (timepoint x Any_RT): Model: arcsin-sqrt(fraction) ~ timepoint * treatment_arm + purity + grade + age + 1p19q + (1|patient). Confidence intervals are profile-likelihood (Wald fallback). BH q is the Benjamini-Hochberg value over the 10 primary types; the permutation p is from 10,000 patient-level treatment-label shuffles (seed 7331). Only NK and Microglia are evaluable; rows for B, MoMF and CD8 T cells carry finite model estimates but are below the evaluability threshold and are descriptive only. The remaining five primary types have no discovery estimate and are omitted here (their Stage 2 annotation status is in Table S8).
